stem: How are the Coralbots discussed in "Robots on the Reef" and the fish transmitters discussed in "Something Fishy" similar?

options.label: A
options.text: Both are designed to independently complete a task.

options.label: B
options.text: Both assist scientists in tracking the amount of ocean life in a specific area.

options.label: C
options.text: Both are meant to be used by scientists to help restore an environment.

options.label: D
options.text: Both are programmed to model the behavior of insects.
